translation.name: Moppiyon Dinoggan, Moka-atag ki Disas Krays

book.name: MARCOS
book.title: Dos Moppiyon Dinoggan no id Sulat ni MARCOS

content: Si Disas diyot Isowwan ni Pilato

To od ka-allow ron, id pomuhawang iddos mgo ponguu to tohodbuwis, dos od pombuyyahon to mgo Judio, dos mgo tohodnonaw to Suhu ni Moises woy dos langun no tohodhukum ko ondan kos od puungan dan ki Disas. Na, id baku ran kos bollad din woy id piyod dan sikandin diyot ki Pilato no gubernador to Roma.
Id inturan ni Pilato si Disas, kahi rin to, “Sikkow vo kos hari to mgo Judio?” Mid tavak si Disas to, “No-oseng dud en.”
Na iddos mgo ponguu to tohodbuwis, mo-uraa kos saa no id uug dan ki Disas.
De-en id intud mandon si Pilato, kahi rin to, “Norinog du iddos mo-uraan saa no id uug dan kikow. Ondan, waa vo id pokotavak du?”
Piru waa en id tavak si Disas, de-en oray'n nosoobbuwan si Pilato.
Dos Kodsilut ki Disas to Kopotayan
Na ipat pista to Kodlihad to Ponolihan, nooyami ron ni Pilato no od poleggua to sokkad no pinirisu nod buyuwon to mgo Judio.
Iddon timpu, duwon mgo minuvu no noprisu pomon to kodsupak dan to guberno. Sokkad kandan, id ngoranan ki Barabas no noko-imatoy to minuvu riyot nosamuk don.
To id undiyot ki Pilato iddos mo-uraan minuvu, id buyu ran nod polegguangon din iddos sokkad no pinirisu, su idda me-en kos od puungan din ipat lahun.
Na mid intud si Pilato kandan, kahi rin to, “Od kopiyan kow vo nod polegguangon ku inis Hari to mgo Judio?”
Id oseng ni Pilato idda, su nosorollan din no iddos mgo ponguu to tohodbuwis, kosina kos unayan no id boggoy ran si Disas diyot bollad din.
Piru id sutsutan taddot mgo ponguu to tohodbuwis iddos mgo minuvu, no iyon dan od buyuwon nod polegguangon, si Barabas, konna si Disas.
Id intud mandon si Pilato, kahi rin to, “Ondak id kopi-i row nod puungan ku ka-ay't minuvu no id ngoranan dow no Hari to mgo Judio?”
Na id pehes dan no mid ungketen to, “Id pakpak sikandin diyon to krus!”
Kahin Pilato kandan to, “Mambo? Ondan man kos saa no nopuungan din?” Piru ayas pe-en id pehes iddos mgo minuvu nid ungketen to, “Id pakpak sikandin diyon to krus!”

De-en id poleggua ni Pilato si Barabas su id kopi-i rin nod kahaa kos mgo minuvu, woy id polompossan din si Disas. Nopongnga, id boggoy rin sikandin diyot bollad to mgo sundau amoy id pakpak diyon to krus.
Dos Kodsumpalit to mgo Sundau ki Disas
Na, id piyod to mgo sundau si Disas diyot lama to baoy't gubernador, woy id livuung dan iddos langun no duma ran no mgo sundau.
Id umpakan dan si Disas tod momoollutun umpak iling to umpak to hari. Id podlambed dan iddos duhiyon no baahon, woy id bovallan dan idda no kuruna no id takos diyot uu ni Disas.
Na, id po-uvag-uvag dan nod posivantug kandin woy kahi ran to, “Muopa nod mowwet kos umuu ru, sikkow no hari to mgo Judio!”
Na id pomipitan dan kos uu rin to bookayu, woy id pon-ilobban dan sikandin, woy id ponlingko-od dan diyot isowwan din no uvag kun tod simba ran kandin.

Nopongnga ran sikandin tid sumpalit, id lusut dan iddos od momoollutun umpak woy id posukub dan mandon iddos kandin no umpak. Nopongnga, id piyod dan sikandin diyot leggua amoy id pakpak diyon to krus.
Dos Kodpakpak ki Disas diyon to Krus

Laggun to riyon sikandan to daan, nokosuggung dan to sokkad no minuvu no toho Cirene no id pomon diyot bariyu. Id pohos dan sikandin nod tiyang taddot krus ni Disas. (Dos ngaran din, si Simon no amoy onni Alejandro woy Rufo).
Id piyod dan si Disas diyot lugaa nod ngoranan to Golgota, no iddos kohulugan, lugaa to Bongovongo.
Od boggayan dan si Disas to binu no id sombutan to bawi nod ngoranan no mira,
piru waa sikandin id inom tadda.
Na, id pakpak dan sikandin diyon to krus. Id bunutbunut dan atag taddot ogget ni Disas ko ondan kos od kokomunoy to ipat sokkad kandan.
Mgo alas nuwebe to sollom kos uras to kodpakpak dan ki Disas diyon to krus.
Na riyot korotula, nokosulat iddos saa no id uug dan kandin no mid ungketen to, “Ini en si Disas no Hari to mgo Judio.”
Na, duwon oruwon kriminal no id pakpak dan mandad diyon to krus no riyot tapad ibpit ni Disas. Iddos sokkad, diyon lomig to kowanan din woy dos sokkad, diyon lomig to ivang.
[Ukit ka-ay, notuman iddos no-ikahi riyot Nosulat no Kahit Monama no mid ungketen to,

content.text: “Diyot kod-ontong to mgo minuvu, id po-iling sikandin to sokkad no kriminal.”

content: Na iddos mgo minuvu nid lihad dutun, id ponlingi-lingi ran woy id sumpalit dan sikandin. Kahi ran to, “Tomman du, od gobban du iddos templo woy'd poohinaton du mandon daom da to otollun allow!
Otik mooggot en iddos id oseng du, tovangiyu kos ko-ugolingun du woy ponog ka ruwot krus!”

Ungketen dad en mandad kos id puungan taddot mgo ponguu to tohodbuwis woy dos mgo tohodnonaw to Suhu ni Moises. Id sumpalit dan sikandin, kahi ran to, “Te, id tovangan din kos duma, piru dii man sikandin od pokotavang to ko-ugolingun din!

Otik bonnaa en no sikandin kos Mesiyas no Hari to Israel, od pokoponog nanoy sikandin duwot krus amoy od kokita ta woy'd pomakoy ki kandin.” Na, ahad iddos oruwon minuvu no id pakpak diyon to krus no riyot tapid ibpit din, id sumpalit mandad kandin.
Dos Kopotayan ni Disas
Na, to moko-untud don kos allow, tigkow id mosukirom kos intirut ingod daom to otollun uras.
To alas tres don to mapun, id pehes si Disas to monokkaa no mid ungketen to, “Eloi, Eloi, lema sabactani,” no iddos kohulugan, “Monama ku, Monama ku, mambot id tonanan a nikkow?”
To norinog idda taddot dumon minuvu no id loohinat dutun, mid ikahi sikandan to, “Id umow rin si Elias!”

Na, duwon sokkad no minuvu nid lungkossu woy id angoy sikandin to immat bukoo nid aggom diyot suka, woy id takos din idda riyot ubpu to panga to kayu. Nopongnga, id bullow rin idda amoy id po-inom kandin. Mid ikahi iddos minuvu riyot mgo duma rin to, “Od ongatan ta kod loppow vo si Elias amoy od angoy kandin duwot krus.”
Na, id pehes si Disas to monokkaa woy novudtus don kos songnga rin.
Iddos oray'n mokoppaan kurtina
riyon to templo, novendas pomon diyot datas po-undiyot dosiyung.

To norinog taddot kopitan to mgo sundau no id lohinat diyot isowwan to krus iddos kodpehes ni Disas, woy to nokita rin iddos notomanan, mid ikahi sikandin to, “Mooggot bos en no Anak sikandin to Monama!”
Na, duwon mandad mgo ba-ay nid pomantow. Sikandan onsi Maria no toho Magdala, si Salome, woy si Maria no inoy ni Jose woy dos ari rin no si Santiago.
Sikandan iddos mgo ba-ay no id dumoruma ki Disas, woy id tavang kandin to riyon pa sikandin to Galilea. Duwon mandad mo-uraa pon mgo ba-ay no id duma kandin to kod-undiyon din to Jerusalem.
Dos Kodlobbong ki Disas
Na iddot kodpatoy ni Disas, nokosasang idda to allow to kodpanoy atag to Allow't Kod-imolloy. De-en to id saop don kos allow, duwon minuvu nid inguma no id ngoranan ki Jose no toho Arimatea.

Sokkad sikandin nod rispituwon no sakup to Mowwet no Hukumanan to mgo Judio, woy id aangat sikandin to timpu to kodharit Monama. To iddon mapun, waa sikandin id aang-aang nid undiyot ki Pilato, woy id buyu rin nod ongayon iddos bangkoy ni Disas.
To kodbuyu ni Jose tadda, nosoobbuwan si Pilato, su kunan din ko waa pa id patoy si Disas. Na id po-umow rin iddos kopitan to mgo sundau, woy id inturan din ko mooggot be-en no id patoy ron si Disas.
Id ikahi iddos kopitan to mgo sundau no id patoy ron en si Disas, de-en id aman si Pilato no od ongayon ni Jose iddos bangkoy ni Disas.

Pomon tadda, id ipanow si Jose. Id bolli sikandin to mahaa no ogget, woy id angoy rin iddos bangkoy ni Disas diyon to krus woy id bukusan din idda taddot ogget. Nopongnga, id ta-aw rin idda riyot lovongngan no id bongbangan no pahang iling to langub. Duwon dakkoon batu rutun no id lokkob din taddot lobbong.
Na, nokita ni Maria no toho Magdala woy ni Maria no inoy ni Jose ko ingkon din lomig id lobbong iddos bangkoy ni Disas.

footnotes.text: Inis mira, sokkad no pomammut, piru bawi mandad ini amoy konna oraroy od geddam to mosakit iddos minuvu no id pakpak diyon to krus.

Dos mokoppaan kurtina riyot templo, allang idda amoy konnod poko-usok kos mgo minuvu riyot Uhis no Lugaa to templo. To novendas idda timpu to kodpatoy ni Disas, kilaannan idda no od pokoporani ron kos mgo minuvu riyon to Monama.
